import re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p="scripts/test-megaqml-phase2-contract.py"
size=len(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
try:
    done=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",p],capture_output=True,timeout=25,check=False)
except (OSError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
    sys.exit(90)
# Never print the child's raw stdout or traceback. Report only a bounded,
# validated static assertion source-line number through stdout metadata.
if done.returncode != 1 or done.stdout or b"AssertionError" not in done.stderr:
    sys.exit(91)
hits=re.findall(rb'File "[^"\r\n]*/?scripts/test-megaqml-phase2-contract\.py", line ([0-9]{1,4}), in <module>',done.stderr)
if not hits:
    sys.exit(92)
line=int(hits[-1])
if not 1<=line<=size or size>1000:
    sys.exit(93)
sys.stdout.write("L"*(100+line))
